policy.acronyms: Single-token uppercase acronyms of up to 6 letters require exact case
policy.ambiguity: A surface with multiple eligible canonical concepts remains unlinked
policy.counting: Each accepted occurrence in each actual text field; copied fields count independently
policy.display_label: Lexicographically first informative native label, or explicit identifier if all labels are placeholders; all source labels retained
policy.identity: Exact declared canonical CURIE with normalized recognized prefix; otherwise source-unique ID
policy.interpretation: Includes negated and contextual mentions; lexical counts do not assert scientific claims or interactions
policy.method: dictionary-linked entity recognition; no contextual inference
policy.normalization: Unicode NFKC, casefold, collapse whitespace; punctuation retained
policy.overlap: Leftmost longest whole-word surface; letters, numbers and combining marks belong to words; ambiguous longest spans block nested fallback
policy.pair_unit: One unordered distinct-term pair per discussion, after reader filters
policy.short_forms: Fewer than 3 alphanumeric characters excluded except explicit CURIEs; 3 characters require exact case
policy.span_encoding: Unicode codepoint offsets into original field text

interpretation: Occurrence counts are lexical matches, not evidence of biological interaction or research priority.
